introHtml: Raglan baseball chef wear combines the classic sporty look of raglan sleeves with professional kitchen functionality. This style offers greater mobility in the shoulders and arms, making it ideal for chefs who need unrestricted movement during long shifts. The contrasting sleeve color adds a modern, team-oriented aesthetic that works well for restaurant staff uniforms or culinary school apparel. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a cohesive brand look.
